name: DrillMenu
label: Drill menu
description: A drill-in menu for a phone: one level at a time, thumb-tall rows with a second line, a current value or a chosen mark, and a back row naming its way out.

props.name: items
props.description: The first level's rows and sections. A row with `items` drills into the next level.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: href of the current page: the exactly matching row gets `aria-current="page"` and the current treatment, and every row on the way to it the current treatment.

props.name: path
props.description: The ids of the rows drilled into, first level first: `[]` is the first level. Pair with `onPathChange`.

props.name: defaultPath
props.description:
The path the menu opens on, when it owns its state. Left out, it opens
on the deepest level that holds the current page (`currentHref`, or a
row marked `current`), so a reader deep in a section reopens the menu
where they are; `[]` opens on the first level always.

props.name: onPathChange
props.description: Fires with the new path whenever a row drills in or the back row steps out, in both controlled and uncontrolled modes.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Fires when a link row is followed, alongside native navigation, such as to close the drawer the menu sits in.

props.name: header
props.description: Content above the first level's rows, such as a search field.

props.name: rootLabel
props.description: The back row's text on the second level, naming the first.

props.name: backLabel
props.description: The back row's accessible name, given the title of the level it returns to. Defaults to "Back to <title>".

props.name: overviewLabel
props.description: The overview row's text on a level whose row has an `href`, given that row's label. Defaults to "<label> overview".

props.name: navLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the `<nav>` landmark.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router. Wins over a LinkProvider's; a plain
`<a>` when neither is set.

DrillMenuEntry.description: An entry on a level: a row, or a section of rows.

DrillMenuSection.description:
A group of rows under an optional heading: one level's resources or
settings, say, set apart from the rows above it.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

keys.note: Its rows are links and buttons, and the browser owns Tab, Enter and Space. A step moves focus to the new level’s title, and back to the row it came from on the way out.

alternatives.name: SideNav
alternatives.when: the list sits in a sidebar beside the page and branches should open in place
